import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str((Path.cwd() / "scripts").resolve()))
from sequence_contract import compute_source_digest

session_path = Path("docs/sequence/sessions/SW2-02-GOVERNANCE.json")
session = json.loads(session_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
session["actual"]["source_digest"] = compute_source_digest(Path.cwd())
session_path.write_text(json.dumps(session, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print("SW2_02_SESSION_DIGEST=" + session["actual"]["source_digest"])
